areas.title: Checkout
areas.summary: 42 MB to clone; no submodules or LFS.

areas.title: Tools on the worker
areas.summary: uv 0.4, Node 22 and Docker 24, from .python-version, .nvmrc and compose.yaml.
areas.proposal: [worker] tools lists uv, node and docker.

areas.title: Dependencies in each workspace
areas.proposal: provision runs uv sync and npm ci with a worker-wide cache.

areas.title: Services
areas.summary: compose.yaml starts postgres:16 and redis:7; CI uses the same two.
areas.proposal: One Compose project per workspace; teardown removes it.

areas.title: Database setup
areas.summary: alembic.ini and migrations/; CI runs alembic upgrade head.
areas.proposal: provision migrates once the services are up.

areas.title: Tests
areas.summary: CI runs uv run pytest -m 'not slow' and npm test.
areas.proposal: [tests] command runs both; timeout 900 s until a rehearsal measures it.

areas.title: Secrets and data
areas.ask: Add STRIPE_TEST_KEY as a Project secret, or let the tests that need it skip.

questions.question: Should workspaces receive STRIPE_TEST_KEY, or do the tests that need it skip?
evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml passes secrets.STRIPE_TEST_KEY to the test job.

assumptions: Tests run with uv run pytest -m 'not slow' and npm test, as CI runs them.
postgres:16 and redis:7 start from compose.yaml, one Compose project per workspace.
Migrations run with alembic upgrade head after the services start.
